description: Parallel-tempering random-walk MCMC. Each replica uses Metropolis at temperature T with beta=1/T; adjacent temperatures swap at generation barriers. Coupled barrier schedule (not independent-chain async); see Jarvis man sampler.mcmc-runtime.
x-jarvis-example:
Method: PTMCMC
Bounds:
  num_chains: 4
  num_iters: 2000
  proposal_scale: 0.2
  temperature_ladder: [1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0]
  exchange_interval: 1
  seed: 0
Variables:
  - name: x
    distribution:
      type: Flat
      parameters: {min: 0.0, max: 1.0}

Bounds.description: PTMCMC settings. num_chains is the number of temperature replicas (must be >= 2). Prefer num_chains >= Runtime workers.

num_iters.description: Number of Metropolis transitions per replica.

proposal_scale.description: One positive proposal scale shared by every replica (scalar or homogeneous list).

temperature_ladder.description: Strictly increasing temperatures; length equals num_chains; first entry must be 1.0 (cold).

exchange_interval.description: Attempt adjacent temperature swaps after this many full draws (default 1).

seed.description: Master RNG seed (chain streams + exchange RNG).
